incident_spec.summary: Nested loops join dominates query cost in a multi-table join scenario.
symptoms: Nested loops join consuming 90% of query cost
incident_spec.mechanism: Inefficient join conditions involving OR clauses and large intermediate result sets.

facts.evidence: Query provided in the DBA post.
Execution plan details shared in the post.

value.split_joins: Separate OR conditions into multiple joins.
value.use_coalesce: Replace OR with COALESCE in join conditions.

facts.evidence: Recommendations in the DBA post and answers.

assumptions: The database schema and indexes are as described in the post.
The query structure and execution plan are representative of the production environment.
unknowns: Exact data distribution and cardinality of the involved tables.
Impact of suggested optimizations on the execution plan.

feasibility.rationale: The reproduction requires a SQL Server-compatible environment, which is available. However, exact data distribution and cardinality are unknown, so synthetic data will be used to approximate the mechanism.

requirements: Dedicated test database for synthetic reproduction.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category (category_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_category_id INT, level INT, version_id INT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_voc (category_id INT, language_code VARCHAR(10), category_name VARCHAR(255), PRIMARY KEY (category_id, language_code))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_link (sku_id INT, category_id INT, is_primary BIT, PRIMARY KEY (sku_id, category_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_ids (value INT PRIMARY KEY)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO category (category_id, parent_category_id, level, version_id) SELECT n, CASE WHEN n % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE n - 1 END, 4, 5 FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 10000
INSERT INTO category_voc (category_id, language_code, category_name) SELECT n, 'en', CONCAT('Category_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 10000
INSERT INTO category_link (sku_id, category_id, is_primary) SELECT n, n % 10000, CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 100000
INSERT INTO temp_ids (value) SELECT n FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 10000

tables.name: category
tables.purpose: Hierarchy of categories with parent-child relationships.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution with some NULL parent_category_id values.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT l.sku_id, l.is_primary, v1.category_name, v2.category_name, v3.category_name, v4.category_name, v5.category_name FROM category c4 JOIN category_voc v4 ON v4.category_id = c4.category_id AND v4.language_code = 'en' JOIN category c3 ON c3.category_id = c4.parent_category_id JOIN category_voc v3 ON v3.category_id = c3.category_id AND v3.language_code = 'en' JOIN category c2 ON c2.category_id = c3.category_id JOIN category_voc v2 ON v2.category_id = c2.category_id AND v2.language_code = 'en' JOIN category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id JOIN category_voc v1 ON v1.category_id = c1.category_id AND v1.language_code = 'en' LEFT OUTER JOIN category c5 ON c5.parent_category_id = c4.category_id LEFT OUTER JOIN category_voc v5 ON v5.category_id = c5.category_id AND v5.language_code = 'en' JOIN category_link l ON l.sku_id IN (SELECT value FROM temp_ids) AND (l.category_id = c4.category_id OR l.category_id = c5.category_id) WHERE c4.level = 4 AND c4.version_id = 5
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the query plan includes nested loops join and highlights the inefficiency in the join conditions.
expected_evidence: Nested loops join is used for category_link table.
High cost associated with the join operation.
OR condition in join predicate is visible in the plan.

validation_criteria: Nested loops join is present in the query plan.
Join conditions match the described inefficiency.
symptom_evidence: High cost of nested loops join.
mechanism_evidence: Nested loops join dominates query cost.

experiment_request.target_anomaly: Nested loops join inefficiency due to OR condition in join predicate.
experiment_request.dba_description: Reproduce and analyze the inefficiency caused by nested loops join in a multi-table join query with OR conditions.
